tests.title: Web POS applies the percentage discount only for the configured membership level
tests.goal: Verify that selecting an eligible member applies the configured basket discount and removing the member removes that offer.
preconditions: An active membership basket promotion, an eligible member and a member at another level.
data: For example, 10% off for Level 3 and an eligible HKD 100 item.

steps.text: Log in to Storeberry with a staff account.
Open Web POS for the store covered by the offer.
Add an eligible item as a guest and disable competing basket discounts in this cart if needed.
Remove the member, then select a member at a different level.

expected.text: The named offer is absent for the guest.
The eligible member receives the exact configured discount. A 10% offer on HKD 100 deducts HKD 10.
Removing the member removes that offer; it remains absent for a member at another level.

notes: KN, promotion 679: HKD 100 basket discounted HKD 10 for Level 3 after disabling competing Gold offer. Guest and two verified Level 2 members did not receive level3.

tests.title: Web POS excludes products flagged against whole-order promotions from the membership discount
tests.goal: Verify that a membership basket discount does not discount a product excluded from whole-order promotions.
preconditions: An active membership basket offer and an eligible member. One product is excluded from whole-order promotions and another is eligible.
data: One excluded product and one eligible item.

steps.text: Log in to Storeberry with a staff account.
Open Web POS for a participating store.
Add the excluded product and select an eligible member.

expected.text: The excluded product by itself stays at full price.
After an eligible item is added, the discount applies to the eligible amount only, not the excluded product.

notes: Pinky Star1 has Excluded from whole order promotions checked. HKD 480 alone stayed HKD 480. In a mixed basket only the HKD 100 eligible snack contributed to the discount base (HKD 80 after Gold; level3 HKD 8).
